In the brain, sleep is known to play an important role in incremental learning by replaying recent and old conflicting memory traces. Here we tested\u00a0the hypothesis that implementing a\u00a0sleep-like phase in artificial neural networks can protect old memories during new training and alleviate catastrophic forgetting. Sleep was implemented as off-line training with local unsupervised Hebbian plasticity rules and noisy input. In an incremental learning framework, sleep was able to recover old tasks that were otherwise forgotten. Previously learned memories were replayed spontaneously\u00a0during sleep, forming unique representations for each class of inputs. Representational sparseness and neuronal activity corresponding to the old tasks increased while new task related activity decreased. The study suggests that spontaneous replay simulating sleep-like dynamics can alleviate catastrophic forgetting in artificial neural networks.<\/jats:p>","DOI":"10.1038\/s41467-022-34938-7","type":"journal-article","created":{"date-parts":[[2022,12,15]],"date-time":"2022-12-15T11:11:34Z","timestamp":1671102694000},"update-policy":"https:\/\/doi.org\/10.1007\/springer_crossmark_policy","source":"Crossref","is-referenced-by-count":56,"title":["Sleep-like unsupervised replay reduces catastrophic forgetting in artificial neural networks"],"prefix":"10.1038","volume":"13","author":[{"ORCID":"https:\/\/orcid.org\/0000-0002-6823-719X","authenticated-orcid":false,"given":"Timothy","family":"Tadros","sequence":"first","affiliation":[],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]},{"given":"Giri P.","family":"Krishnan","sequence":"additional","affiliation":[],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]},{"given":"Ramyaa","family":"Ramyaa","sequence":"additional","affiliation":[],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]},{"ORCID":"https:\/\/orcid.org\/0000-0002-1936-0570","authenticated-orcid":false,"given":"Maxim","family":"Bazhenov","sequence":"additional","affiliation":[],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]}],"member":"297","published-online":{"date-parts":[[2022,12,15]]},"reference":[{"key":"34938_CR1","doi-asserted-by":"publisher","first-page":"419","DOI":"10.1037\/0033-295X.102.3.419","volume":"102","author":"JL McClelland","year":"1995","unstructured":"McClelland, J.
